question: What security and ownership boundary should the live browser preview use before implementation?
rationale: The panel would expose sensitive browser state and could be built as core Control UI, a browser-plugin tab, or a broader plugin UI contribution; automation cannot safely choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Read-only-first browser plugin panel
options.body: Use the current plugin tab and browser-control primitives for an admin/operator-scoped panel that shows tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs while requiring explicit user action for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submits.

options.title: Fold into login-handoff tracker
options.body: Treat the broader live preview as a follow-up to the narrower browser login-handoff work so same-profile resume semantics land first.

options.title: Defer behind broader UI RFC
options.body: Wait for the Control UI contribution-slot/API direction to settle before adding browser-specific UI.

recommendation.title: Read-only-first browser plugin panel
recommendation.body: Use the current plugin tab and browser-control primitives for an admin/operator-scoped panel that shows tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs while requiring explicit user action for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from the browser runtime/security history and the existing product-routing comments on the related browser issues.
